description: This source file defines a class `OrderValidator` that implements Spring's `Validator` interface to validate `Order` objects within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes methods for performing various validation checks on order data, such as ensuring non-null fields, date consistency, and correct associations between orders, encounters, and patients. It serves as a rule enforcement component to maintain data integrity for orders in the system.

classes.name: OrderValidator
classes.description: A validator class for validating `Order` objects; it ensures that required fields are present, date fields are consistent, and associations between orders, encounters, and patients are correct.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the provided class is supported by this validator, specifically if it is an `Order` or subclass.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validations on an Order object, checking for nulls, date logic, class consistency, and related entity validation.

methods.name: validateOrderTypeClass
methods.description: Ensures that the `OrderType`'s Java class matches the class of the order or its subclass.

methods.name: validateDateActivated
methods.description: Validates the `dateActivated` field for being in the past, before `dateStopped`, `autoExpireDate`, and after encounter datetime.

methods.name: validateSamePatientInOrderAndEncounter
methods.description: Checks whether the patient associated with the order matches the patient in the encounter.

methods.name: validateScheduledDate
methods.description: Validates the scheduled date field relative to the urgency setting.

methods.name: validateOrderGroupEncounter
methods.description: Ensures that an order in a group has the same encounter as the order group.

methods.name: validateOrderGroupPatient
methods.description: Ensures that an order in a group has the same patient as the order group.
